Privacy policy

Your information.
Handled with care.

Last updated: 14 November 2026. This notice covers the AI Legal website and direct email enquiries.

Who is responsible

AILL LLC, doing business as AI Legal, United States, operates this website. Contact milos@ai.legal with privacy questions or requests.

Browsing this website

This website serves static articles and research descriptions. Its application code does not set cookies, use browser storage, run advertising or analytics trackers, or provide accounts, contact forms, payments or document uploads. Fonts and graphics are served with the site rather than loaded from third-party font or image services.

The hosting provider may process technical information such as IP addresses, request times, browser information and requested URLs to deliver and secure the website. The GitHub Pages version is hosted by GitHub; see the GitHub Privacy Statement. The provider serving a deployment may change during migration, and this notice will be updated if the site’s data practices change.

When you email us

If you contact us, we receive your email address, name if supplied, message and any information you choose to include. We use that information to respond, manage the enquiry, keep relevant correspondence and meet applicable legal obligations. Our email provider processes correspondence to deliver and store messages.

Please send only information needed for the enquiry. Do not send confidential client documents, health information, government identifiers, financial credentials or passwords.

Purposes, legal bases and retention

Where data protection law requires a legal basis, we process ordinary enquiries for our legitimate interests in responding and operating the website; information necessary to discuss a requested engagement may be processed to take steps at your request before an agreement; and records may be retained to comply with legal obligations.

We retain correspondence only as long as reasonably needed for the enquiry, any resulting relationship, applicable recordkeeping requirements or resolution of disputes. Technical log retention is controlled by the hosting provider. We do not promise a fixed deletion period that we cannot enforce for provider logs.

Disclosure and international processing

Information may be processed by hosting and email providers acting for us, and disclosed where necessary to comply with law, protect rights or address security issues. Providers may process data in the United States and other countries. Where legally required for transfers, applicable safeguards must be used. We do not sell personal information or use it for targeted advertising.

Your choices and rights

Depending on where you live and applicable law, you may have rights to request access, correction, deletion, restriction or portability of your personal information, or object to certain processing. Email us to make a request. We may need proportionate information to confirm your identity. You may also complain to the relevant data protection regulator.

External links and AI services

Links to social networks or other websites take you to services with their own privacy practices. This site does not run an AI chatbot or send visitor messages or documents to an AI model. If a future service adds AI processing, its data practices will need to be disclosed before it is made available.

A separate business profile or conversation on ChatGPT is governed by that service’s policies. This website does not itself give AI Legal access to individual ChatGPT conversations.

Security and children

Use HTTPS to access this site. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure. The content is intended for a general professional audience and is not directed at children under 13. Please contact us if you believe a child has sent personal information.

Changes

We will update this page when the website’s data practices change. The date above identifies this version of the notice.
